ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) clusters; estimated macro-ratio of 9:1 black-to-white distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are distributed as discrete circular points across the medial fluke and as dense, irregular masses at the distal tips; the background is a continuous low-intensity black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with a pixel angle approximately between 130 and 140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (saw-tooth pattern) present along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of valleys and peaks increases significantly from the notch toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge boundary from the central notch to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (3-12 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes, with a high density of overlapping rosettes at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths (15-60 pixels) visible primarily on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular jaggedness and white calcification/scarring at both distal tips, suggesting previous tissue loss or significant barnacle colonization sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent high-contrast white 'C' shaped mark on the left-central lobe and multiple intersecting white linear vectors on the right-central lobe.
